Minimal image for the cachyos AUR route: the cachyos base plus one candy that
declares a single AUR package. Nothing else — no workload, no service — so the
only thing a build of it can prove or fail on is whether the declaration is
routed to a builder box and installed.

It declares no `builder:` map of its own: the route is inherited from
`base: cachyos`, which routes `aur` to `arch.arch-builder`. A box that had to
repeat that map would be the duplication this mechanism exists to remove.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `aur-probe`
- `@github.com/opencharly/plugin-builder-aur/candy/plugin-builder-aur:v2026.327.0012`
